title: Izandla Eziqalekisiwe
intro: Umi ezindleleni ezigobile zaseMakkah yasendulo, lapho umphefumulo onethonya nengcebo wake wafulathela khona ubizo lweqiniso. Indaba yalo muntu iyisikhumbuzo esicacile sokuthi izibopho zegazi azikwazi ukunqoba izibopho zokuziqhenya. Ubani lo ogama lakhe lihambisana nomlilo olindele?
clues: Ngahamba emigwaqweni yaseMakkah ngokuziqhenya okwangenza ngangaboni iqiniso, yize isithunywa sasingowegazi lami.
Izimpahla zami zaziziningi, kodwa zaba yisiqalekiso kunokuba zibe yisihlangu.
Incwadi yesiqondiso ikhuluma ngokubhubha kwami, imemezela ukuthi izandla zami kanye nomzimba wami kuzobhubha.
Umlingani wami wajoyina umkhankaso wami wobutha, eqoqa ameva ukuze asakazeke endleleni yalowo obiza u-Allah.
Ngosuku lokwahlulela, ngizocwiliswa emlilweni womlilo ovuthayo, kanti umlingani wami uzoba nentambo yesundu entanyeni.
Ngaziwa ngegama elisho ukuthi 'uyise womlilo' — igama elibikezela indawo yami yokuhlala yaphakade.
